tasks.label: CMake: build debug
tasks.detail: Build all targets using the debug preset. Explicitly enters the VS dev shell itself (scripts/build.ps1) rather than relying on CMake Tools' environment auto-injection, which turned out to only reliably apply to a build directory CMake Tools configured itself.
